text:
The last two decades of the artist's life were relatively unproductive as ill health and 
blindness hindered her ability to work. O'Keeffe died in 1986 at the age of ninety-eight, but 
her rich legacy of some 900 paintings has continued to attract subsequent generations of 
artists and art lovers who derive inspiration from these very American images.
